REGULATION (EU) 2016/679 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL

of 27 April 2016

Whereas:

(1)

The protection of natural persons in relation to the processing of personal data is a fundamental right.

(2)

The principles of the protection of natural persons should respect their fundamental rights.

CHAPTER I

General provisions

Article 4

Definitions

For the purposes of this Regulation:

(1)

‘personal data’ means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person (‘data subject’);

(2)

‘processing’ means any operation which is performed on personal data;

(3)

‘restriction of processing’ means the marking of stored personal data as defined in Directive 95/46/EC (1);

CHAPTER II

Principles

Section 1

Lawfulness

Article 6

Lawfulness of processing

1. Processing shall be lawful only if at least one of the following applies:

(a)

the data subject has given consent;

(b)

processing is necessary for:

(i)

the performance of a contract;

2. Member States may maintain more specific provisions.
